title: The best thing in Motril
text: Motril is an agro-industrial city with no significant sights. The best thing you can do there is eat tapas. The tour went to three typical local spots serving classic Spanish cuisine. Very personal tour, as there were only two participants. To finish, an ice cream of the highest caliber (Italian style). Good entertainment and very interesting insights into Spanish life for a small price. Spanish home cooking that you wouldn't otherwise order.
author: 44MichaelG
